events.event_name: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21-27 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A mobile consumer activation celebrating Jung Saem Mool Beauty's Sephora launch with Van Leeuwen ice cream, moving between Manhattan stops near Sephora locations.
events.what_is_free: Guests can receive a special JSM Beauty × Van Leeuwen ice cream by following @jsmbeauty_global. A social-post giveaway of full-size Metal Lip Serum is limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: Open to the public. The complimentary ice cream requires following @jsmbeauty_global; the full-size lip-serum social giveaway is limited to 200 units per day. The first Lexington Avenue stop's exact street number was not published in the sources reviewed, so it is not guessed here.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: 11 AM-1 PM Lexington Avenue; 1:30-3:30 PM at 557 Broadway; 4-7 PM at 21-27 9th Avenue. Sept. 20 follows the same first two stops and ends 4-6 PM at 21-27 9th Avenue.

events.what_it_is: Two-day reopening celebration for Credo Beauty's revamped SoHo boutique with gifting, giveaways and in-store raffles.
events.what_is_free: The first 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase required; product raffles also require no purchase. A separate gift with purchase is available at $100+.
events.caveats: Credo explicitly says RSVP is not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. Free gifts are first-come, first-served, limited to the first 150 shoppers each day, while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM-7 PM; Sunday Sept. 20, 11 AM-6 PM. RSVP is optional; arriving early matters for the first-150 gift.

events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A café-inspired CHANEL fragrance experience for COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU with personalized fragrance discovery, the wider COCO MADEMOISELLE line, hair/body products and makeup.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the fragrance discovery experience are free. Products are available for purchase onsite.
events.caveats: CHANEL says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged. An appointment is therefore optional rather than required and does not replace normal capacity constraints.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19 and Sept. 20 hours are 10 AM-7 PM at 873 Washington Street. Walk-ins are welcome; appointments are recommended/limited.

events.event_name: TRUBAR × Cha Cha Matcha TRU Matcha Experience
events.what_it_is: Public launch event for the TRUBAR × Cha Cha Matcha collaboration, including limited-edition matcha/protein offerings, merchandise and a golden-ticket giveaway.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests in line receive limited-edition merch and a ticket to try the new menu items and Love You So Cha Cha Matcha bars. Select guests receive a golden ticket for a year of TRUBAR.
events.caveats: The event is public, but the first-50 merchandise/sampling benefit is capacity-limited and while supplies last. Collaboration shirts and pouches are separately available for purchase.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19 at Cha Cha Matcha Flatiron, 922 Broadway. Secondary event listing gives 8 AM-6 PM; TRUBAR's release confirms the Sept. 19 launch and first-50 promotion.

events.address: 315C Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: Grand-opening weekend for Tatte's first New York City café, with neighborhood celebration activities.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Matcha & Pistachio Rose Lattes with Táche, live illustrations, build-your-own bouquets and special-edition merchandise while supplies last.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Promotional items are available from 8 AM until they run out; specific quantities were not published in the sources reviewed.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19 and 20 beginning at 8 AM, with promotional activities continuing until supplies run out. The café itself is open daily.
